續租失敗可能是伺服器離線或單播路徑失效，而重新繫結結果可不同。 比較單播RENEW與廣播REBIND回覆，並驗證交易識別碼和client identifier。
對照「DHCP：資料契約與分層建模」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。未到期租約不因一次續租逾時失效；有明示選項時重算而非套預設比例。
本階段必須重驗：第1項研究的可複查條件：手算1800、3150、3600 s，檢查T1<T2<租約到期；新組3600、6300、7200 s。 交接時須能核對：分開租約起點、T1、T2、到期四欄，並記錄伺服器是否有覆寫選項。
steps.instructionEn:
Renewal can fail because of server loss or a unicast-path failure, while rebinding may behave differently. Compare unicast renewal and broadcast rebinding replies and verify transaction and client identifiers.
Against the nominal DHCP: Data contract and layered model result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. A lease does not expire after one renewal timeout; recompute explicit options instead of using defaults.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 以 RFC 2131 的「DHCP」作具名案例，研究以下介面或演算法：DHCP租約具有續租與重新繫結階段；伺服器可明示T1/T2，不能總是假定預設比例。 本課從明示的離線資料建立證據，不要求接觸營運網路。
knowledge.textEn: Use RFC 2131 as the named primary case for DHCP: lease T1/T2 and address-pool capacity. DHCP leases have renewal and rebinding phases; servers can supply T1/T2, so default ratios are not universal. Build evidence from explicit offline fixtures without accessing operational networks.
